title: Pure Traptrix
summary: Traptrix cards with the "Hole" Normal Traps they search and react to, generic Insect and Plant Extra Deck monsters, and staples. Traptrix monsters are immune to Hole Traps, and each Hole Trap they spring keeps the engine going. Traptrix Myrmeleo searches a Hole, Nepenthes fetches a Traptrix whenever you activate one, and Traptrix Sera pulls a Traptrix from the Deck after any Normal Trap. The 2023 cards lead. Traptrix Pudica searches Traptrip Garden, which grants an extra Traptrix Normal Summon and summons one from the hand or GY. Traptrix Arachnocampa summons itself on either Main Phase and protects your Set cards. Traptrix Holeutea becomes a monster and revives a Traptrix. Traptrix Pinguicula searches a Traptrix, and Traptrix Atypus negates their cards. Arachnocampa limits the Extra Deck to Insects and Plants.
